source_statements.source_statement: Create or continue a canonical run/register for the transcript/Drive/class intake rebuild.
Re-check current audit artifacts and verify the previously reported counts instead of blindly trusting them.
Define Drive/app DB as raw transcript vault and GitHub as digest memory.
Build a privacy-safe repo digest export and do not run the raw transcript exporter as-is.
Classify mixed recordings by section into class, question, task, content, private, operations, Drive workflow, parser, and review lanes.
Generate repo-side digests, manifests, categories, routing, and safe indexes without raw transcript bodies.
Produce sanitized transcript gap manifests for the 24 GitHub transcript export gaps.
Produce dry-run repair candidate manifests for the 10 repair candidates.
Produce a Drive transcript library dry-run plan only, with no Drive writes or AI calls.
Run focused tests, privacy scan, JSON checks, secrets audit if feasible, and git diff check.
Keep raw transcript export, Drive writes, paid retranscription, production mutation, worker retry, and backfill blocked unless explicitly approved.
Verify that the Drive folder named 01 Transcript Library exists and contains older transcript docs such as jobs #65 through #70.
Verify the addendum's newest-doc gap: no transcript-library docs created after 2026-06-25T00:00:00Z and no confirmed Drive transcript doc for content_job:83.
Keep the sequence read-only Drive audit, dry-run Drive sync plan, safe repo digest export, and only owner-approved Drive create/update.
Keep no production mutation, no Drive write/move, no paid retranscription, no raw tracked transcript export, no stale deletion, and no class backfill.
Owner approves one non-dry-run Drive transcript library sync for the missing private Drive transcript doc for content job #83 only.
Allowed command is npm run content:sync-drive-library -- --no-ai --verify --job-id 83.
After the sync, verify Drive readback, update sanitized repo evidence with a Drive status/link or redacted pointer, and rerun privacy-safe digest export and audits.

Everything outside job #83 remains forbidden, including production DB mutation, class backfill, Drive source move/delete, paid retranscription, AI calls, raw transcript export to GitHub, stale deletion, sends, charges/access grants, credential/account/DNS changes, and broad Drive sync.
Register PR #45 content-card/topic-filter addendum and keep Issue #41 open.
Audit all 29 digest recordings for title, parse, digest, routing, topic, category, and next-action readiness.
Fix bad, gibberish, or missing Operations Content card titles and show clean generated title, main points, summary, categories, parse status, digest status, routing status, and next action.
Fix the top topic filter so it uses normalized topic/category data from digest and classification output, including multi-topic cards and All reset behavior.
Make uncategorized or incomplete items show clear Needs title, Needs parse, Needs digest, Needs routing, and Needs topic classification states.
Add tests and perform no Drive writes, production mutations, class backfill, AI call, or raw transcript export.
Continue Issue #41 in goal mode until safe parsing, backlog, content cards, questions, tasks, and research repair requirements are terminal.
Make PR #45 mergeable and get the content-card/topic-filter repair live when safe.
Run a fresh read-only Drive/class/content audit for current backlog state.
Fill backlog, questions, research/content cards, tasks, parse status, and routing status from Drive-backed transcript/digest evidence where safe.
Kids scores and student questions need to be updated after the parser backlog is repaired.
Do not silently mutate production student records, perform broad Drive writes, export raw transcript bodies, or run class backfill without exact reviewed approval.
Finish with evidence, PR/issue updates, live proof where app-visible, and exact remaining blockers.
